name: Kevin Rovner Band
description: A four-piece groove band that grew out of the John & Peter's scene, where it began as the club's go-to fill-in act in 2016. Its debut live album, Live in New Hope, came out in 2025.
activity: Played John & Peter's, New Hope, July 11, 2026

name: The Invitational
description: A revolving lineup of local and touring pros that has held a Wednesday-night residency at John & Peter's for years. Guest players drop in often, so no two nights are the same.
activity: Weekly Wednesday shows at John & Peter's through Oct 2026 (Oct 1, 8, 15, 22, 29)

name: Those Looks
description: A Lambertville four-piece formed in 2018 that mixes dreamy, reverb-heavy pop with grunge, surf and country touches. It released the album Cults Near Me in 2022 and the EP Passing Through in 2025.
activity: Played John & Peter's, New Hope, May 10, 2026 (also Dec 2025)

name: Gobot
description: A rock trio from Titusville started by members of the local bands Sage, Mixxtape and Crucial. It presents itself as a champion of human-made rock and roll.
activity: Recurring John & Peter's dates Oct 7, Nov 4 and Dec 23, 2026; Dharma Bums, New Hope, Nov 25, 2026

name: Wineskin
description: A five-piece Bucks County rock band whose sound runs from slow country ballads to heavy, riff-driven jams. It is often compared to Widespread Panic and Gov't Mule.
activity: Pre-Thanksgiving show with Gobot at Dharma Bums, New Hope, Nov 25, 2026

name: Slow Noche
description: A New Hope trio that plays original instrumentals with Latin, island and noir flavors. Its moody, cinematic sound owes something to Marc Ribot and Big Lazy.
activity: Opened for Big Lazy at John & Peter's in March 2026; headlining Dharma Bums, New Hope, Dec 3, 2026

name: The New Hope Nonet
description: A nine-piece jazz group led by arranger and tenor saxophonist Mike Kaplan. It plays fresh arrangements of Ellington, Mingus, Monk, Shorter, Sun Ra and others.
activity: Dharma Bums, New Hope, Nov 22, 2026, with a return date Jan 24, 2027

name: The Real Fugitives
description: A horn-backed rock band led by songwriter Larry Feldman that mixes its own songs with reworked classic-rock covers. It plays regularly around Lower Bucks and New Hope.
activity: John & Peter's Sept 19, 2026; Fran's Pub, New Hope, Oct 17, 2026; John & Peter's Dec 19, 2026

name: The Kelly Jax Band
description: A rock trio fronted by Kelly Jax, who sings while playing drums, with Marc Jaxheimer on guitar. Based in North Bucks near the Lehigh Valley.
activity: Played John & Peter's Jan and Apr 2026; TGI Fridays, Quakertown, Dec 12, 2026

name: Cherry Lane Band
genre: Rock / R&B cover band with horns
description: A Doylestown band with a horn section that has played rock and soul covers for more than 20 years. Its sets run from Chicago and Steely Dan to Bruno Mars.
activity: Played the Doylestown Arts Festival, Sept 12-13, 2026

name: Big Chill Band
description: A six-piece rock and roll cover band with a following in central Bucks. It is a regular at township summer concert series.
activity: Played the Doylestown Arts Festival, Sept 2026

name: Hay Sugar
description: A rock act that Patch listed among the festival's local fan favorites. In 2026 it played both the Doylestown Arts Festival and the borough's free Concerts at the Commons series.
activity: Concerts at the Commons, Doylestown, May 28, 2026; Doylestown Arts Festival, Sept 2026

name: Away Message
description: An alternative band that the festival's 2026 announcement named as one of its local favorites.
activity: Played the Doylestown Arts Festival, Sept 2026

name: The Great Bonfire
description: A rock band billed as a local favorite at the Doylestown Arts Festival, where it had a late-afternoon slot.
activity: Played the Doylestown Arts Festival, Sept 2026

name: The Dave Woodward Band
description: A local Bucks County band that donated its time to headline an outdoor Stage United benefit for the county's breast cancer community.
activity: Printer's Alley Pink Pop-Up Concert, Doylestown, Oct 24, 2026

name: Pennington Station Band
description: A harmony-driven acoustic rock group that has played year-round since 2006. It is a fixture of Hopewell Township's summer concerts at Woolsey Park.
activity: Free concert at Woolsey Park, Hopewell Township, July 23, 2025; listed again for the 2026 series (Aug 19, 2026)

name: Far Away Guys
description: A Newtown-area group that plays classic rock, blues and alternative covers along with some original songs.

name: Definitive Groove
description: A local band that plays funky takes on hits from the 1960s to today.
activity: Played Newtown Porchstock at St. Luke's Episcopal Church, Sept 26, 2026

name: Free Men in Paris
description: A Newtown-area cover band that plays rock and pop from the 1960s to today.
activity: Played Newtown Porchstock at Boone Garden, Sept 26, 2026
